examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five objections a buyer raises before signing, each written the way the reader would ask it. Every answer starts closed, so the band opens as a scannable list of questions rather than a wall of prose. Edit `title` and `items` in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders no frame at all.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Faq from '@aziontech/webkit/faq'
</script>

<template>
  <Faq
    title="Frequently asked questions"
    :items="[
      {
        value: 'pricing',
        question: 'How does pricing work?',
        answer:
          'You pay for what you use — requests, data transfer and compute time — with no seats and no upfront commitment. Usage is metered and billed monthly.'
      },
      {
        value: 'free-tier',
        question: 'Is there a free tier?',
        answer:
          'Yes. Every core product has a monthly free allowance, and billing starts only once you pass it.'
      },
      {
        value: 'migration',
        question: 'How much work is it to migrate?',
        answer:
          'Most teams move a first workload in a day. Point the domain at us, keep the origin where it is, and cut traffic over once the numbers look right.'
      },
      {
        value: 'compliance',
        question: 'Where does my data run, and are you compliant?',
        answer:
          'You choose the regions a workload and its data are allowed in. Current audit reports and certifications are available on request.'
      },
      {
        value: 'support',
        question: 'What support do I get?',
        answer:
          'Every account has documentation, community and email support. Paid plans add a 24/7 incident channel and a named engineer.'
      }
    ]"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Framed
examples.summary: `framed` makes the band draw its own registration frame, for a page that places it in a column with no frame of its own.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Faq from '@aziontech/webkit/faq'
</script>

<template>
  <Faq
    title="Billing questions"
    framed
    :items="[
      {
        value: 'invoice',
        question: 'When is the invoice issued?',
        answer: 'On the first day of each month, for the usage of the month before.'
      },
      {
        value: 'currency',
        question: 'Which currency is it billed in?',
        answer: 'Every account is billed in USD.'
      },
      {
        value: 'cancel',
        question: 'Can I cancel at any time?',
        answer: 'Yes. Usage stops being metered the moment the last workload is deleted.'
      }
    ]"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Rich answer
examples.summary: The `answer` slot replaces each rendered answer, so an answer can carry a link: here every answer ends on a link to the page that settles it.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Faq from '@aziontech/webkit/faq'
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'

  const items = [
    {
      value: 'limits',
      question: 'What are the request limits?',
      answer: 'Each plan has its own limits.'
    },
    {
      value: 'status',
      question: 'Where can I see the platform status?',
      answer: 'On the status page.'
    }
  ]

  const links = {
    limits: { label: 'Read the limits for every plan', href: 'https://example.com/docs/limits' },
    status: { label: 'Open the status page', href: 'https://status.example.com' }
  }
</script>

<template>
  <Faq
    title="Frequently asked questions"
    :items="items"
  >
    <template #answer="{ item }">
      {{ item.answer }}
      <Link
        :label="links[item.value].label"
        :href="links[item.value].href"
      />
    </template>
  </Faq>
</template>
